name: Retro Revival Car
region: United States, Germany, Britain and Italy
summary: A new car with the shape of an old one: a round Beetle, a small Mini or a long-bonnet Mustang. It has chrome trim, round lamps and a painted dashboard.

philosophy.core_thesis: A new car can borrow the face of a loved old one. It must keep the key shapes and add the comfort and safety of today.
design_principles: Copy the key shapes of the old car: the roof, the round lamps and the grille, at 90 to 110 percent of the old size.
Make the body bigger than the old one by 5 to 15 percent, to meet crash rules.
Fit round lamps, a chrome ring on each, and a grille in the old pattern.
Paint a panel of the dashboard in the body colour, with chrome rings on the dials.
Add chrome trim as a bright accent on the door handles, the mirrors and the grille.
Offer two-tone paint, a stripe, a roof in a second colour and a retro badge.
Hide the modern parts: airbags, screens and sensors, behind the retro surface.
anti_patterns: A new shape with no link to the old car
A copy that is exact in all sizes, with no modern safety

silhouette.shape: A body with the key outline of a past car: a round bubble roof, a long-bonnet coupe or a short box. It is now bigger and taller, with a modern stance.
silhouette.line: The old line, repeated with a higher waist, a deeper wing and larger wheels.
silhouette.fit: A cabin with the space and safety of a new car, but with the dials and the dash of the old one.
silhouette.proportion: Length 3.6 to 4.8 m; the body is 5 to 15 percent bigger than the original; the wheels are 16 to 19 inches.
rules: Keep the original face: the lamp shape, the grille and the badge.
Raise the waist line to meet today's crash rules.
Offer a roof in a second colour or a bonnet stripe.
Set a dash panel in the body colour, with round dials and a chrome ring.

fabrics.rule: Use a modern steel body and plastic parts. Use chrome and painted metal to give the retro look. Use a cloth or leather cabin with a period pattern.

methods: modern steel body with a retro outline
round lamps with chrome rings and modern projectors
a body kept at a scale of a modern safety cell
construction.closures: Chrome or body-colour door handles, a remote key and a retro-style push button.
construction.details: Round lamps with a chrome ring, a retro grille, a painted dashboard, a chrome ring on each dial, a bonnet stripe and a vintage-style badge.

surface.pattern: A bold bonnet and roof stripe, a two-tone body and a houndstooth or plaid seat insert.
surface.gloss: Paint at 80–90 GU; chrome at more than 90 GU; the painted dash at 70–80 GU.
surface.wear: Chrome trim keeps its shine under a clear lacquer; the plastic dash scratches; owners keep these cars for their look.

palette.strategy: A light, friendly colour or a period colour, with a white roof or stripe, chrome accents and a dash in the body colour.

processes: a design drawn from a heritage car
a steel safety cell with a retro outer skin
making.scale: Mass-made in series of tens or hundreds of thousands; the retro look is a feature that sells the car.
making.signs: The old outline in a bigger body, round lamps with a chrome ring and a dash panel painted in the body colour.

pieces.form: Round-roof small car with round lamps and a chrome ring
Long-bonnet coupe with a retro grille and a stripe
Dash with a panel in the body colour and chrome-ring dials
Seat with a houndstooth cloth insert and a leather edge
Chrome grille, door handles and mirror caps

emotion.target_response: A warm, nostalgic smile: the viewer sees a loved old car that has come back in new, safe form.

use_cases: a lifestyle advertisement for a heritage-inspired car
a car interior concept with a painted dash
an image prompt for a retro new car
a design history lesson on nostalgia
avoid_when: the brief wants a pure modern or electric look
the brief wants a real period car
the brief wants a sharp sports car

modifiers.how: Remove the chrome and the paint panel, flatten the surfaces and use one screen.
Drop the heritage details, round the body and paint the bumpers in body colour.

ornament_level.note: Chrome and paint panels carry the old look; keep the rest plain.
